title: Assessing the Capabilities of LLMs in Humor: A Multi-dimensional Analysis of Oogiri Generation and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM evaluation scores of irrelevant (Unrelated) and low-tier human Oogiri responses to human annotations to identify systematic overvaluation and leniency by the models.

Comparing how LLMs rate AI-generated Oogiri responses versus human responses, revealing that LLMs tend to rate AI outputs as comparable to or better than high-tier human answers, contrasting with human judgments.
Analyzing differences in LLM evaluation tendencies and generation performance between text-based and image-based Oogiri topics to identify model-specific preferences for certain input formats.
